features.name: Document camera scan with auto edge detection
features.description: Live camera view that finds the page edges, shows a highlighted quad overlay, and captures a perspective-corrected page. Can use VisionKit's VNDocumentCameraViewController or a custom AVFoundation camera with Vision rectangle detection.
features.reason: This is the main job of the app. It runs fully on-device.

features.name: Batch multi-page capture
features.description: Capture several pages in one session. They are appended to the same document in order, with thumbnails visible before saving.
features.reason: The listing calls out batch mode. Multi-page documents such as contracts and receipts depend on it.

features.name: Manual crop and perspective adjust
features.description: After capture, the user can drag four corner handles with a magnifier loupe to fix the detected edges. Pages can be re-cropped later from the page viewer.
features.reason: Auto-detection fails on cluttered backgrounds. Users need a reliable fallback.

features.name: Enhancement filters
features.description: A horizontal strip of filter previews applied with Core Image: Original, Lighten, Magic Color (boosted contrast and saturation with a white background), No Shadow, Grayscale, and Black & White. The first screenshot shows a filter strip with a slider on the selected option to set strength.
features.reason: Clean, readable output is the core value of a scanner.

features.name: Rotate and reorder pages
features.description: Rotate a page in 90° steps. Reorder, duplicate or delete pages within a document by dragging in a grid.
features.reason: The rotate button is in the main page toolbar. Page order matters for exported PDFs.

features.name: On-device OCR with Image/Text toggle
features.description: Run Vision text recognition on a page. A segmented control switches between the scanned image and the recognized text. In text mode the text can be selected, copied and edited, and the user can re-run recognition.
features.reason: Shown in several screenshots. The paid app paywalls it, but Vision provides it for free on-device.

features.name: Full-text search
features.description: Search the library by document title and by stored OCR text. Matching pages are highlighted.
features.reason: The listing promotes finding files by their contents. Indexing the stored OCR text is cheap.

features.name: Export as PDF without watermark
features.description: Generate a multi-page PDF with PDFKit. The output never carries a watermark.
features.reason: The paid app watermarks PDFs and some reviews say it even blocks saving PDFs without a subscription.

features.name: Export as JPG and TXT
features.description: Export page images as JPEG files (one per page or zipped). Export OCR text as a plain .txt file.
features.reason: These formats are advertised and are trivial to produce locally.

features.name: Export as Word or Excel
features.description: Produce a simple .docx (or RTF) from OCR paragraphs. Detected tables can be exported as CSV or simple .xlsx.
features.reason: Advertised, but faithful layout and table reconstruction is hard. A simple text-flow document is an honest approximation.

features.name: PDF export settings
features.description: Before export, choose page size (A3, A4, A5, Letter, Legal, Executive, or a custom size), orientation (auto, portrait, landscape), page-number position (none, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right), and an optional password set via PDFKit document write options.
features.reason: Shown in screenshots. Encryption and page numbers are paywalled in the original but cost nothing locally.

features.name: Share via system share sheet
features.description: Share as PDF (showing file size), as images, as a long stitched image, or as text through UIActivityViewController. Mail, messaging apps and Files all come from the system. Sharing should take as few taps as possible.
features.reason: Sharing is a primary outcome. Reviews complain that sharing has more and more steps and about a broken email layout.

features.name: Share as long image
features.description: Stitch all pages of a document vertically into one tall image for messaging apps.
features.reason: Shown in the share sheet. It is easy with UIGraphicsImageRenderer.

features.name: Print
features.description: Print through UIPrintInteractionController at the document's real page size, with no unexpected scaling.
features.reason: A review says printed scans shrink and cannot be adjusted.

features.name: Signature
features.description: Draw a signature with PencilKit and save it for reuse. Place it on a page, then move, resize and recolor it before flattening it into the export.
features.reason: Promoted in a screenshot and paywalled in the original. Signing is a frequent reason people scan.

features.name: Markup tools
features.description: Highlighter, pen annotations, an eraser, a text box, and an image or watermark overlay on a page. Annotations are stored separately so they stay editable.
features.reason: Shown in the markup menu. Useful, but secondary to scanning.

features.name: ID card and passport mode
features.description: A guided mode that captures the front then the back of an ID card and lays both sides onto one A4 page at real card size. A passport mode captures the photo page.
features.reason: Shown in a screenshot. A review complains ID scanning stays locked even after paying.

features.name: Book mode
features.description: Capture an open book spread and split it into two pages along the spine.
features.reason: Visible as a capture mode tab. Narrower use case.

features.name: Import from Photos, Files and share extension
features.description: Create documents from existing photos, PDFs or screenshots, using PhotosPicker, the document picker, and an action/share extension.
features.reason: A review reports importing a screenshot through the share sheet is broken.

features.name: Library organization
features.description: Folders, tags, sorting by date or name, list or grid view with thumbnails, and renaming documents.
features.reason: Described in the listing as document management.

features.name: Document lock
features.description: Lock individual documents or the whole app behind Face ID or Touch ID or the device passcode, using LocalAuthentication.
features.reason: The listing mentions password-protecting files. This is a local implementation.

features.name: Flash and torch control
features.description: Off, auto, on and torch modes for the capture camera, with flash correctly synchronized to the captured frame.
features.reason: A review reports flash timing leaves shadows on scans.

features.name: Translate recognized text
features.description: Translate OCR text using Apple's on-device Translation framework where available.
features.reason: Paywalled in the original. Only acceptable if done with the system framework and no network calls from the app.

features.name: Account, cloud sync and backup
features.description: Sign-up with phone or email, server backup, and cross-device sync.
features.reason: Requires an account and a server. Reviews show forced sign-in caused lost access to documents.

features.name: Cloud storage upload integrations
features.description: Direct upload to Google Drive, Dropbox or Box.
features.reason: Needs network and third-party accounts. The system share sheet and Files already cover this.

features.name: Fax sending
features.description: Send scans by fax using purchased credits.
features.reason: Needs a server and paid credits. It is also the source of several complaints.

features.name: Send to PC / edit on computer / Wi-Fi transfer
features.description: Push files to a desktop web client or transfer over a local web server.
features.reason: Requires a server or network service.

features.name: Watermark, ads and premium tiers
features.description: Branded watermark on exports, ads, storage quotas and subscriptions.
features.reason: Contrary to the Sbu model.

flows.name: Scan a multi-page document
steps: Tap the scan button in Library
Point the camera at the page; edges are detected and captured automatically or with the shutter
Repeat for more pages; the thumbnail count increases
Tap Done
Adjust corners on each page if needed
Pick a filter, optionally applying it to all pages
Save; the document appears in Library with a date-based title
OCR runs in the background and is stored for search

flows.name: Extract and copy text
steps: Open a document and tap a page
Switch the Image/Text control to Text
Select a range or use Copy all
Optionally edit the text and save it
Export as TXT or share the text

flows.name: Sign a document
steps: Open the page to sign
Tap Sign
Choose a saved signature or draw a new one
Drag and resize the signature on the page
Tap Done; the signature is stored as an annotation
Export as PDF with the signature flattened

flows.name: Scan an ID card
steps: Open Capture and select the ID Card tab
Align the card front in the card-shaped guide and capture
Flip the card and capture the back
The app crops both sides and lays them on one A4 page at real size
Save and export as PDF or image

flows.name: Export a password-protected PDF
steps: In Document Detail, tap Export
Choose PDF
Open PDF Settings
Set page size, orientation and page numbers
Enable password and enter it twice
Tap Done, then share or save to Files

flows.name: Import a screenshot or photo
steps: From another app or Photos, use the share sheet action, or use Import in Library
Selected images open in Crop & Adjust
Apply a filter
Save as a new document or add to an existing one

flows.name: Find a document by its content
steps: Type in the Library search field
Results match titles and OCR text
Open a result; the matching page is shown with the term highlighted

flows.name: Print a scan
steps: Open a document
Tap Print
The system print dialog opens at the document's page size with 100% scaling
Print

data_model.storage: SwiftData for metadata and OCR text. Page images are stored as files in Application Support/Documents/<docID>/ and included in the normal device backup. No account, no server and no network access. Store data carefully across app updates (versioned SwiftData schema migrations) so scans are never lost or locked behind a sign-in.

monetization.notes: Everything the original paywalls is free: OCR, PDF export without watermark, signatures, ID scan, PDF password and page numbers, unlimited storage and no ads. Cloud sync, fax and send-to-PC are left out because they need servers. Documents are never gated: export and share always work.

user_pains.pain: Paid for the app up front but still hit a subscription paywall for basic features such as saving PDFs, ID scanning, or even reaching the app
user_pains.evidence: Several reviewers say they bought the app and were still asked for a monthly or yearly fee. They say scans could not be saved, ID scan stayed locked, and they could not get past the premium screen.

user_pains.pain: Documents lost or held hostage after updates, device changes or subscription changes
user_pains.evidence: Data vanished after an update, files disappeared a day after moving to a new phone, and one user says existing documents became inaccessible without paying yearly.
Users are asked for a phone number or email code. The verification email never arrived, and a new-phone setup demanded an account as if the user were new.
Users could not top up fax funds, could not send even after paying, and saw available pages but no way to send.
The app became glitchy and slow after an iOS update and crashes on an older iPhone.
Sending through Outlook leaves the send button hidden behind the status bar, and sharing a PDF keeps gaining extra steps.
A reviewer who paid for the app still got a watermark and a premium upsell.

user_pains.pain: Importing from the share sheet broken
user_pains.evidence: Importing a screenshot through the iOS share sheet stopped working after an iOS update.
Printing a scanned document shrinks it and the size cannot be adjusted.

user_pains.pain: Flash not synced with capture, leaving shadows
user_pains.evidence: The flash fires but the captured scan still shows shadows, while the system camera works fine.
